decisions.reason: The cleaning soap complements the firm's established flooring offer, and its in-house R&D gives it the related knowledge to interpret results and refine the product.
The maintenance oil line builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment know-how, so early market feedback can be assimilated and used to improve it.
Care products for oiled floors fit the firm's existing oiled-floor offer and accessory knowledge, which supports learning and continued development.
The moisture-protection underlay is a matching accessory within the firm's flooring system expertise, and its installation guidance helps it judge performance.
The high-density underlay foam extends the firm's accessory range, but it overlaps somewhat with Product D, so a modest risk of consolidation remains.
Oak parquet sits at the core of the firm's wood-processing know-how and is supported by its own R&D, making it highly likely to be kept.
